content: विज्ञानम् .²1 Knowledge, wisdom, intelligence, understanding; यज्जीव्यते क्षणमपि प्रथितं मनुष्यैर्विज्ञानशौर्यविभवार्यगुणैः समेतम् . तन्नाम जीवितमिह … <ls>Pt. 1. 24</ls>, <ls n="Pt.">5. 3</ls>; विज्ञानमयः कोशः ‘the sheath of intelligence’ (the first of the five sheaths of the soul). .²2 Discrimination, discernment. .²3 Skill, proficiency; प्रयोगविज्ञानम् <ls>Ś. 1. 2</ls>. .²4 Worldly or profane knowledge, knowledge derived from worldly experience (<ab>opp.</ab> ज्ञान which is ‘knowledge of Brahma or Supreme Spirit’); ज्ञानं तेऽहं सविज्ञानमिदं वक्ष्याम्यशेषतः <ls>Bg. 7. 2</ls>, <ls n="Bg.">3. 41</ls>, <ls n="Bg.">6. 8</ls>; (the whole of the 7th Adhyāya of <ls>Bg.</ls> explains ज्ञान and विज्ञान). .²5 Business, employment. .²6 Music. .²7 Knowledge of the fourteen lores. .²8 The organ of knowledge; पञ्चविज्ञानचेतने (शरीरे) <ls>Mb. 12. 187. 12</ls>. .²9 Knowledge beyond the cognisance of the senses (अतीन्द्रियविषय); विज्ञानं हि महद्भ्रष्टम् <ls>Rām. 3. 71. 30</ls>. .²10 Information; लब्धविज्ञानम् <ls>Mb. 12. 44. 5</ls>.
